articles.summary: Green Plains Inc. (NASDAQ: GPRE) today announced the appointment of Allan Williams as General Counsel and Corporate Secretary, effective November 2, 2026. Williams has served as interim General Counsel since August 2026, providing continuity and leadership across the company’s legal function while supporting a number of key business and strategic priorities. “Allan has stepped in and made an immediate impact at Green Plains,” said Chris Osowski, President and Chief Executive Officer. “He knows our business, understands the ethanol industry, and brings the practical legal and transaction experience we need to help us thoughtfully evaluate opportunities to create shareholder value as our financial flexibility increases. He has earned the confidence of our leadership team, and I’m pleased to have him in this role.” Williams brings extensive legal, corporate development and transaction experience, with deep familiarity with the ethanol and renewable energy industries.
